claimed_component: (g)(3)(A)(i) continuing education in the school of origin and (g)(3)(B) 'School stability'; supports Y1.13 school stability for homeless youth

notes: Checked on the govinfo official text and on Cornell LII. The labels are exact: (g)(3)(A)(i) is school of origin and (g)(3)(B) is headed 'School stability'. These are LEA duties based on the child's best interest, not outcome measures. The ellipses join separate subdivisions.

cite_as: 42 U.S.C. 675(1)(G), case plan: educational stability of the child while in foster care
claimed_component: 675(1)(G): plan for ensuring the educational stability of the child while in foster care, including remaining in the same school at each placement; supports Y1.13 foster-placement school stability
excerpt: (G) A plan for ensuring the educational stability of the child while in foster care, including—
notes: The label (1)(G) is correct. On 'remaining in the same school', the claim simplifies the statute: (ii)(I) requires an assurance of LEA coordination 'to ensure that the child remains in the school in which the child is enrolled at the time of each placement', with immediate enrollment in a new school as the alternative in (ii)(II). Also checked on Cornell LII.
